description: Create a named board in the user's Sightglass collection. A board holds one kind of item: ad, site_page (landing pages), company (brands) or persona. Returns the board and its id.

kind.description: What the board holds; a board takes one kind of item.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects: where the charge or the asset lands. Its workspace's plan applies.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Sets which workspace's plan applies; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_create_board
title: Create board
